items.author: MotherDuck, making a warehouse "agent-ready", Nov 7
items.summary: In a DABstep test, agent accuracy rose from 29.8% on a raw schema to 93.2% after clear schemas, column comments, views for complex logic, and short SQL and domain docs. 27 reactions, 3 comments, 5 reposts.

items.author: Moritz Stefaner, BikeNetKit, Nov 9
items.summary: Open-source bike-network planning tools for 412 European cities, with maps you can export as PNG, SVG or GeoJSON, built with the NERDS group at IT University of Copenhagen. 76 reactions, 3 comments, 8 reposts. [BikeNetKit](https://bikenetkit.org/)

items.author: Mohamed EL-Mazariki, AgenticProject for Power BI, Nov 7
items.summary: A prototype agent on Azure AI Foundry that reads a Power BI semantic model, writes and runs DAX, and builds native Power BI visuals from plain-English questions. 15 reactions, 1 comment.
